itens.trecho: Um filme muito simples, mas muito humano, com sentimentos e diálogos muito bons. Ao contrário daquilo que gosto de fazer, vi este filme depois de ter visto a sua sequela, “Antes do Anoitecer”.

After about five minutes of this, I was resigned to watching a reimagining of "Brief Encounter" (1945) and started to give up. Then, it began to take an altogether different tack as we meet a young and fairly penniless American "Jesse" (Ethan Hawke) who starts chatting with "Celine" (Julie Delpy) on a train journey and there is a visually striking chemistry…

A very simple but very human film, with very good feelings and dialogue. Contrary to what I like to do, I saw this film after seeing its sequel, “Before Sundown”. It's a very nice story about an American tourist who is enchanted by a French student he meets on the train on the way to Vienna, and invites her to spend some time with him.
